en.headline: Couple arrested after money dispute turns physical in Sau Mau Ping
en.dek: A 65-year-old man and his 55-year-old wife were arrested on Saturday morning after an argument over money in their On Tai Estate flat; the woman was treated for a headache.
body: Police arrested a married couple in Sau Mau Ping on Saturday morning following a domestic dispute. Officers were called to a flat in Chi Tai House, On Tai Estate, at about 7.18am after a report of an assault involving a knife.

According to police, the 65-year-old man and his 55-year-old wife argued over money. The husband allegedly struck his wife with his hands, while the wife picked up a kitchen knife. The man was uninjured; the woman complained of a headache and was taken to United Christian Hospital for treatment.

Both were arrested — the man for common assault and the woman for possession of an offensive weapon — and detained for further inquiries. The case is being handled by Sau Mau Ping District Crime Squad.

zh.headline: 秀茂坪夫婦因金錢爭執動粗 先後被捕
zh.dek: 周六早上，安泰邨一對夫婦因金錢問題爭執，丈夫襲擊妻子，妻子則持菜刀，兩人分別涉普通襲擊及藏有攻擊性武器被捕。
body: 秀茂坪安泰邨智泰樓一單位周六早上發生家庭糾紛。約上午7時18分，一名65歲李姓男子報案，指遭55歲林姓妻子以刀襲擊。
警方到場初步調查，相信兩人因金錢問題爭執，期間丈夫以手襲擊妻子，妻子則手持菜刀。丈夫沒有受傷，妻子報稱頭痛，清醒被送往基督教聯合醫院檢查。
兩人分別涉嫌普通襲擊及藏有攻擊性武器被捕，現正被扣留調查，案件交由秀茂坪警區刑事調查隊跟進。
